visual_action: A fast-paced montage shows various scenes of U.S. law enforcement or border patrol agents in action. Clips include a helicopter flying low over a body of water with jet skis, agents in tactical gear walking, an agent with a K-9 unit, a large formation of agents marching on a street and on a training ground, and agents disembarking from a helicopter. The final shot is a black-and-white image of the White House.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video is posted by the @whitehouse account and ends with a title card that reads "THE WHITE HOUSE".

cast.name: Tom Homan
cast.evidence: He appears on screen in one shot, wearing a baseball cap and a green jacket, standing with other officials and uniformed personnel.

cast.name: U.S. Border Patrol
cast.evidence: The video is a montage of uniformed and tactically-equipped law enforcement agents conducting operations involving helicopters, boats, and large ground formations, consistent with the activities of border security agencies.

audio_music: An upbeat, energetic hip-hop track, identified as "Big Guy" by Ice Spice, plays throughout the entire video. The song's driving beat creates a confident, modern, and 'hype' mood for the montage of law enforcement visuals.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various B-roll clips.
cultural_references: SpongeBob SquarePants (the song is from "The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants")
Ice Spice (the artist of the song)
The video uses a popular TikTok format of a fast-paced montage set to a trending song to convey a 'mood'.
central_claim: The White House will maintain a strong and unwavering deportation policy through the year 2026.
intended_effect: To project an image of strength and unwavering resolve regarding immigration enforcement, and to make the policy feel modern and popular by using a trending song.
